image_description: A stocky, dark-furred wombat is curled up in a resting position within a rocky enclosure or burrow entrance. The animal has a robust, barrel-shaped body with coarse brownish-grey fur. Its head is broad and blunt, tucked slightly downwards. Short, powerful limbs are visible, particularly the forelimbs which appear to have digging claws. The background consists of textured rock surfaces and shadows, suggesting a naturalistic habitat.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal sits low to the ground with a very low center of gravity, appearing dense and heavy.

The rear of the animal is tucked into the curve of its body and against the rock wall, making the tail area completely occluded. It cannot be verified visually.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal is in a resting crouch, but the limb placement and body height relative to the ground confirm a low-slung, plantigrade-adapted anatomy.
